name: Tasselverdict
description: Opens with one cut from each edge in turn to show the school's paired grip.

name: Driftvoyage
description: Steps in two matched paces so the blade's two edges stay square to the opponent.

name: Sainted Guardwing
description: Covers the body with one edge toward the opponent and the other held ready behind it.

name: Eddycrown
description: Chains a cut with one edge into a cut with the other along a mirrored line.

name: Faithful Jianhilt
description: Rolls the blade so the second edge takes over the parry when the first is passed.

name: Commanding Knotcord
description: Binds the opposing blade between both edges' qi so it cannot slip from either side.

name: Swirlbanner
description: Thrusts twice along paired lines so each point enters where the other parried.

name: Unwavering Pommeltuft
description: Turns the blade over a parry so the second edge cuts back across the opponent.

name: Noble Ripple
description: Cuts with both edges in turn so quickly that a guard splits under the second.

name: Matchless Quenched Twinspine
description: The school's stroke that sends one cut to the target from both edges' sides at once.

name: Flexcrown
description: Draws a cut with the body track leading and qi following at an interval.

name: Eddyboon
description: Sends qi ahead of the foot so the step lands on an already-opened path.

name: Venerable Springtip
description: Holds one guard with the body and a second with qi spread along the blade.

name: Rippletriumph
description: Weaves a thrust from the body track into the qi track mid-extension.

name: Enshrined Twinspine
description: Parries with the body track and returns the force along the qi track.

name: Ruling Ridgecrest
description: Crosses the two tracks over the opposing blade so it is held from two directions.

name: Liltverdict
description: Slashes while retreating on one track and attacking on the other.

name: Triumphant Swirl
description: Pierces a guard by sending body and qi through the same gap together.

name: Rippledecree
description: Sweeps in a pass where the two tracks overlap and double the weight at the end.

name: Magnificent Tassel
description: Rends a guard with a stroke whose body and qi tracks arrive together and cannot be parried apart.

name: Sovereign Flexspine
description: The school's stroke that unites body track and qi track into one edge of equal weight.

name: Splendid Knotcord
description: Opens with a curving cut over the guard like a hawk crossing a river.

name: Liltgrace
description: Walks the edge of the opponent's reach as along a river bank.

name: Sacrosanct Guardwing
description: Holds the blade across the current of an attack so it divides around the body.

name: Serene Pommeltuft
description: Reads small tremors in the opposing blade as reeds show a hidden current.

name: Lordly Springtip
description: Thrusts along the line the opponent's force is already flowing.

name: Inviolate Jianhilt
description: Breaks a cut against the bank of the blade and turns its force aside.

name: Swirlcrown
description: Slashes from above and behind the opponent in a long diving curve.

name: Subjugating Twinspine
description: Draws the opposing blade into a spiral and holds it at the center.

name: Imperial Flitter
description: Dives at the opponent along the line of the river with the point leading.

name: Magmaripple
description: Rolls a wave-crest of qi along a broad sweep that strikes every foe in its path.

name: Royal Eddy
description: Crosses the whole line of defense in one leap and cuts as the hawk lands.

name: Sovereign Radiance Springtip
description: The school's stroke that falls from height along the current and pierces where the river runs fastest.

name: Heroic Pommeltuft
description: Cuts at full arm's length from the rim of the stance's basin.

name: Tasselsolace
description: Steps along the border of the fighting ground to hold the opponent inside it.

name: Immaculate Waistbend
description: Holds a wide low guard that gathers incoming cuts into the middle of the stance.

name: Driftdecree
description: Draws the point back then thrusts at maximum reach in a single gathered motion.

name: Undefiled Guardwing
description: Parries twice in a pair of linked turns that keep the opponent at distance.

name: Unbending Knotcord
description: Circles the opposing blade into the middle of the stance and holds it there.

name: Valiant Lilt
description: Drives a thrust from the deepest point of the stance across the whole reach.

name: Duneswirl
description: Sweeps the full arc at the edge of reach to cut any foe trying to cross it.

name: Exalted Twinspine
description: Cuts at the edge of reach so cleanly that the opponent never sees it begin.

name: Peerless Flexspine
description: The school's final stroke that closes the boundaries of a fight in one measured cut.

name: Famed Waistbend
description: Cuts upward on a long rising line that lifts the opponent's guard.

name: Flexgrace
description: Climbs forward by rising on the toes at each step to raise the angle of attack.

name: Devout Ridgecrest
description: Spreads both arms wide with the blade high to cover the whole upper body.

name: Eddytriumph
description: Rises on a column of qi and thrusts downward from the top of the climb.

name: Stately Pommeltuft
description: Sweeps the blade out like a pinion feather to clear a heavy cut aside.

name: Phantasm Guardwing
description: Flashes the edge in a high arc to draw the eye while the true cut comes low.

name: Despotic Springtip
description: Lifts the opposing blade high with the flat and holds it there.

name: Gallant Swirl
description: Stoops from the highest guard in a thrust that gains force over the full fall.

name: Solarlilt
description: Sweeps the edge up in a vast arc that cuts every foe before the swordsman.

name: Majestic Flitter
description: Brings a long falling cut down from the full height of the rise.

name: Peerless Ripple
description: The school's stroke that drops from open sky along the edge and lands with the weight of that height.

name: Triumphant Knotcord
description: Cuts in a long flowing line that follows the whole width of the opponent's body.

name: Willowboon
description: Steps up the line of the opponent's attack as against a river toward its source.

name: Revered Twinspine
description: Sinks into a deep still guard that absorbs the weight of a blow without ripple.

name: Luminous Ridgecrest
description: Reads the opponent's intent from the quiet that comes before a strong current.

name: Eddybanner
description: Thrusts along the deepest line of the opponent's guard where the current runs strongest.

name: Undaunted Jianhilt
description: Parries in a fast tumbling turn that shatters the force of a heavy cut.

name: Imperious Pommeltuft
description: Draws the opposing blade down into a still pool of qi and holds it.

name: Noble Swirl
description: Chops down from a great height with the continuous weight of a fall.

name: Vaunted Lilt
description: Thrusts with the entire gathered weight of a river's course behind the point.

name: Kernel Tassel
description: Floods the whole front with a broad sweep of qi that strikes every foe inside it.

name: Storied Ripple
description: Pours every stage of a river's course into one long cut of rising weight.

name: Majestic Deluge Ridgecrest
description: The school's stroke that carries a river's whole course into the sky in one cut.

name: Lordly Tassel
description: Draws the blade on the wind's rising breath after speaking the first word of the oath.

name: Ripplesolace
description: Sets the feet as if swearing to the ground and paces forward from that stance.

name: Consecrated Guardwing
description: Braces the guard against the wind so the blade cannot be forced aside.

name: Lilttriumph
description: Thrusts on the wind with the oath held steady through the extension.

name: Sainted Pommeltuft
description: Parries by turning the blade as the oath turns the heart against a threat.

name: Authoritative Twinspine
description: Locks the opposing blade and holds it while the oath is spoken in full.

name: Flexbanner
description: Slashes out on the wind and returns the edge along the same line.

name: Heroic Flitter
description: Rides the sworn wind into a thrust that nothing on the line can turn.

name: Squalldrift
description: Sweeps a gust of qi in a wide arc that cuts every foe on the swordsman's sworn side.

name: Matchless Waistbend
description: Rends a guard with a cut that carries the gathered weight of a sworn gale.

name: Paramount Tassel
description: The school's stroke in which the oath and the wind and the edge arrive as one.

name: Dauntless Ridgecrest
description: Cuts along a bearing taken on the opponent from a distant marker.

name: Driftgrace
description: Walks from marker to marker across open ground in measured paces.

name: Venerable Waistbend
description: Braces on open ground with the whole stance turned toward the bearing.

name: Swirlverdict
description: Takes a bearing and thrusts along it without adjusting the line.

name: Faithful Twinspine
description: Turns on the plateau and parries so the bearing stays fixed on the opponent.

name: Masterful Knotcord
description: Binds the opposing blade and walks the opponent along the rim.

name: Unrivaled Springtip
description: Drives a thrust along a bearing taken at the start of the exchange.

name: Ripplecrown
description: Sweeps the blade along the bearing in a long arc that never wavers.

name: Splendid Lilt
description: Sunders the guard with a cut aimed along the bearing from the first step.

name: Exalted Prism Flitter
description: The school's stroke that takes one bearing from the plateau and holds it to the end.

name: Intrepid Tassel
description: Draws the blade out on a rising gust to open the course.

name: Flexvoyage
description: Paces forward with the whole body exposed and no rear support.

name: Enshrined Guardwing
description: Turns the guard with the opponent's movement so it never stands still.

name: Wise Jianhilt
description: Listens to the shape of the wind around the opponent to learn the coming cut.

name: Tasselbanner
description: Threads a thrust through a gap in the guard on a narrow gust.

name: Devout Springtip
description: Sweeps the blade wide in a parry that moves the whole body off the line.

name: Peremptory Ridgecrest
description: Slips a bind with a gust-quick turn and binds again from the other side.

name: Eddyedict
description: Slashes with sudden speed from an unexpected angle like a gust off a ridge.

name: Imperial Springtip
description: Thrusts across open ground on a gale that no wall or guard stands against.

name: Tempestuous Twinspine
description: Sweeps the blade through a field of gale that cuts every foe along the front.

name: Gallant Waistbend
description: Strikes on open ground with the whole gale behind the cut and nothing to slow it.

name: Triumphant Flexspine
description: The school's stroke that passes through any guard because the gale holds no walls.

name: Noble Pommeltuft
description: Draws the sworn edge across the opponent as the first line of the oath ends.

name: Tasselodyssey
description: Stands and steps as if each pace were a clause of the oath.

name: Undefiled Ridgecrest
description: Holds the edge across the body while the oath is spoken in the mind.

name: Rippleedict
description: Thrusts the sworn point straight at the heart of the guard.

name: Sacrosanct Pommeltuft
description: Turns an opposing cut by the weight of the held oath.

name: Tyrannous Guardwing
description: Holds the opposing blade at the edge until the oath is finished.

name: Fearless Lilt
description: Drives the sworn edge forward in a thrust the oath will not let falter.

name: Bedrock Flexspine
description: Sweeps the edge in a broad sworn arc that cuts every foe before the swordsman.

name: Lordly Ripple
description: Pronounces the oath in a single cut that finishes the sentence and the guard together.

name: Illustrious Vigor Waistbend
description: The school's stroke in which the whole oath is spoken on the edge as it falls.

name: Vaunted Springtip
description: Cuts with a long reach as the far wind lends its push to the arm.

name: Liltsolace
description: Strides across the plateau in a long even pace that never rises from the ground.

name: Undaunted Ridgecrest
description: Holds the blade across the body in a gust so it cannot be torn aside.

name: Driftcrown
description: Thrusts at the end of a long stride with the far wind behind the point.

name: Revered Guardwing
description: Breaks a cut against a gust of qi and turns it wide.

name: Nightmare Knotcord
description: Lets the blade drift on the wind so the opponent misjudges where the cut will fall.

name: Ruling Springtip
description: Presses the opposing blade to the ground and holds it as the wind pushes the blade.

name: Heroic Eddy
description: Thrusts across a great span with the plateau wind stretching the reach of the point.

name: Entropy Tassel
description: Sweeps a long arc of qi across the flat ground that reaches every distant foe.

name: Sovereign Lilt
description: Throws the cut across the plateau on a gust so it lands at the opponent's far side.

name: Exalted Ripple
description: The school's stroke that lets the whole plateau wind carry the cut across any distance.

name: Paramount Knotcord
description: Cuts along a bearing held without a break from the first step to the last.

name: Eddyvoyage
description: Takes long patient steps that hold one heading for hours of movement.

name: Sacrosanct Twinspine
description: Holds the guard in one unwavering position through a long exchange.

name: Tranquil Springtip
description: Fixes a far mark behind the opponent to keep the bearing true.

name: Liltdecree
description: Thrusts along a line that has not been broken since the exchange began.

name: Stately Jianhilt
description: Parries and returns the point to the held bearing in the same motion.

name: Despotic Ridgecrest
description: Holds the opposing blade and advances with it still bound along the bearing.

name: Triumphant Tassel
description: Slashes along a bearing that was taken a long way back in the exchange.

name: Matchless Flitter
description: Drives an unbroken thrust along the held bearing through every attempt to turn it.

name: Nucleus Flexspine
description: Sweeps in a pass that carries the patience of a long march in its weight.

name: Magnificent Swirl
description: Strikes along a bearing held without a break so that nothing in the stroke can be turned.

name: Heroic Steel Springtip
description: The school's last stroke that keeps its bearing past every wind and every guard.
